text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shortly after the Takarazuka Kinen, summer camp arrives. On the surface, everything appears business as usual with Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, her expression occasionally darkens, and her depression is too much to hide.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I really want to help. Symboli Rudolf, who has also noticed something is amiss, encourages me to support Air Groove to the best of my ability.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Symboli Rudolf behind me, I work toward giving Air Groove a comeback and restoring her confidence at the Sapporo Kinen.
